read.en: Corning rose 2.6% on Nov 6 to $106.13, trading $104.07–110.50. It is below the falling 5-day ($115.5), 10-day ($121.5), 30-day ($138.7) and 100-day ($158.1) and the rising 200-day ($156.2) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero and widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($124.25), and RSI is 30, near oversold.
read.zh: 康宁 11月6日上涨 2.6%，收于 $106.13，盘中区间 $104.07–110.50。股价位于下行的 5 日（$115.5）、10 日（$121.5）、30 日（$138.7）和 100 日均线（$158.1）以及上行的 200 日均线（$156.2）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方且差值扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$124.25），RSI 为 30，接近超卖。

read.en: No level changed: the $110.50 high failed at the $110 resistance lost on Nov 5. Resistance is $110, then $114.2–115.5 (Nov 5 high, Jul 28 and Nov 4 lows, 5-day) and $120.5–121.5 (Oct 30 low, 10-day). Support is $104.1 (Nov 6 low), then $99.5–101.8 (Jan 29 and Nov 5 lows, $100) and $91–95.7. A close above $110 would target $114–115; below $104.1, $100–102.

r.en: Nov 5 high $114.2; Jul 28 low $114.5; Nov 4 low $115.4; 5-day average $115.5
